title: Invariance of an unaffected input block
statement: Let $s,w\in\mathbb N$, let $x\in\{−1,1\}^{sw}$, and let $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(sw)$ specify a coordinate, whose block index is the first component of its corresponding pair in $\mathrm{Fin}(s)\times\mathrm{Fin}(w)$. For any block $t\in\mathrm{Fin}(s)$ different from that block, flipping coordinate $i$ in $x$ leaves block $t$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: block index $t$ differs from the block containing $i$
